requirements.why_needed: Mission 1 has real still/video fixtures but no production-ready same-ISO darkframe sidecar, so nonzero noise removal/addback must stay disabled for this camera.
required_evidence: at least four true no-scene-signal darkframes under one camera/ISO/CFA/dimensions key
lens/body cap or equivalent no-light capture confirmation
original DNG/GPR paths and SHA-256 source hashes
little-endian uint16 Bayer extraction receipts for every frame
strict source-provenance manifest with extracted raw SHA-256, original source SHA-256, extraction receipt, no_scene_signal=true, and capture_setup/proof for every frame
gpr.darkframe_source_provenance_audit.v1 receipt path and SHA-256 with production_ready=true and ready_frame_count >= 4
fixed make, model, dimensions, CFA phase, bit depth, black level, white level, ISO, and exposure
acceptance: darkframe candidate audit groups at least four Mission 1 frames under one camera/ISO/CFA key
camera-noise calibration builder runs with --require-source-provenance and emits gpr.camera_noise_calibration.v1 with production_ready=true
sidecar records source hashes, fixed camera metadata, per-plane sigma, source_provenance_ready=true, and separates_noise_from_signal=true
camera-noise runtime policy enables nonzero denoised targets/noise addback only for exact matching sidecar classes

requirements.why_needed: Current near-time high/low pairs are useful diagnostics but produce an unstable native PSF kernel. A PSF-conditioned 4K/8K replacement needs controlled same-scene data, but this is a next-generation research path and does not block shipping the approved current 4K cleanup and 8K SR workflow.
required_evidence: original high-resolution and low-resolution GPR/DNG paths with SHA-256 source hashes
decoded little-endian uint16 Bayer paths, byte counts, dimensions, CFA phase, and SHA-256 hashes for both sides of every pair
extraction receipt paths and SHA-256 hashes for the high and low decoded Bayer files
settings receipt path and SHA-256 hash proving fixed ISO, exposure, white balance, lens mode, stabilization, sharpening, and lens-correction state
PSF measurement receipt path and SHA-256 hash proving accepted or rejected pair status
fixed ISO, exposure, white balance, lens mode, stabilization, sharpening, and lens-correction state
locked camera and static scene confirmation
negative controls labelled as moved-camera, changed-scene, or mismatched-settings pairs with rejected_by_measurement=true and rejection_reason
acceptance: pair inventory reports at least three decoded native high/low Mission 1 candidate pairs
each accepted pair records 8192 x 6144 high-resolution Bayer and 4096 x 3072 low-resolution Bayer dimensions
decoded Bayer byte counts equal 100663296 bytes for high-resolution inputs and 25165824 bytes for low-resolution inputs
measurement plan selects at least three controlled pairs
native PSF measurement accepts at least three pairs after scene/alignment vetting
accepted pairs provide at least 96 sharp-edge and 96 texture-field tiles
combined kernel has no invalid negative weights and max normalized-weight std <= 0.10
negative controls fail for alignment or scene mismatch rather than tool errors
native_psf_ready_for_model_conditioning=true

requirements.why_needed: The still-SR pipeline, target builders, specialists, and raw-CFA residual trainers exist, but current no-REF residual/local-CNN models remain diagnostic and do not clear the production still/editor-latitude gate. The next launchable attempt must pass the premium still-SR candidate preflight before spending long training time.
required_evidence: checkpoint hash and training config
training target hash with runtime_inputs limited to candidate raw, camera metadata, and validated optional noise sidecars
50 MP and 100 MP full-frame raw-domain gates with row counts
positive 50 MP and 100 MP median MAE reduction, with nonnegative worst-row MAE reduction
raw-editor latitude review at exposure offsets
worst-row visual dashboard
editable DNG/GPR output receipts
timing and memory receipt for the offline render path, including seconds per 50 MP frame, seconds per 100 MP frame, and peak RSS
camera-noise policy receipt proving noise is conditioning or exact-sidecar calibrated addback, not source-content leakage
acceptance: candidate beats current still-SR baselines on 50 MP and 100 MP holdouts
runtime_inputs includes candidate_raw and camera_metadata
no REF/source/JPEG image content is used at render time
full_frame_gate_50mp_row_count and full_frame_gate_100mp_row_count are at least 1
median_mae_reduction_pct_50mp and median_mae_reduction_pct_100mp are greater than 0
worst_row_mae_reduction_pct_50mp and worst_row_mae_reduction_pct_100mp are not negative
raw-editor latitude review has no severe worst-row failures
noise removal/addback is enabled only for exact camera/ISO classes with validated sidecars and source residual noise is forbidden
render_seconds_per_50mp_frame, render_seconds_per_100mp_frame, and peak_rss_gb are recorded
promotion receipt is registered only after the gate passes
